summary: page-tab Vue component (section number tab). Props navNum, size, direction and theme; data navInfo is the (navNum-1)th entry of the nav list from module 49, and computed hideEnLabel is true for store lang "en-us"/"id-id". It renders div.section-nav (with size/direction classes and has-theme) containing an optional svg.section-nav-bg path filled with the theme colour, and .section-nav-inner with .section-nav-label (i18n word pageNavChara for navNum 2, else navInfo.mi18nKey, via innerHTML), a v-show .section-nav-en label (<mi18nKey>Label) and .section-nav-num ("0" + navNum). Normalised with the vue-loader componentNormalizer (module 36); styles from module 1134.

exports.a: page-tab Vue component (section nav label with number)
